notes: Real stations: CSN national network C1 via EarthScope FDSN (open data). Areas: Natural Earth 10m admin-1 regions. Vs30: USGS Global Vs30 (Heath et al. 2020, doi:10.1177/8755293020911137) - 17/18 stations get grid values; Antofagasta falls on a product ocean cell (constant 600 m/s fill, masked to nodata) and samples the bilinear blend of its land neighbours instead of the ocean fill. Regional tsunami: GEBCO 2025 megathrust strip 19S-46S (0.05 deg water-mean) - ocean epicenters inside it run the nonlinear SWE solver on the regional grid (standalone, coarse-grid nesting needs the global grid to cover it; no landuse Manning roughness and no JMA-area ETA panels outside Japan). Published epicenters of the 1960 Valdivia preset sit on a land cell at 0.05 deg (+17 m) - nudge it offshore to run the tsunami; the 1960 and 1908-type sources involved slip distribution beyond a point source either way.
